description: LAYER 2: Frontend URL Path Fixes - Fix broken API paths in frontend that call wrong backend routes
steps: 1. In apps/frontend/src/hooks/useTTS.jsx: Change the fetch URL from `${API_BASE}/voice/tts` to `${API_BASE}/chat/tts`. The backend TTS endpoint is registered at /api/v1/chat/tts (on the chat router).

2. In apps/frontend/src/utils/api.jsx: Change all 3 chat-feedback references from '/chat-feedback' to '/chat/feedback'. Specifically: (a) postChatFeedback uses '/chat-feedback' -> change to '/chat/feedback', (b) adminGetChatFeedback uses '/chat-feedback?limit=...' -> change to '/chat/feedback?limit=...', (c) adminGetFeedbackStats uses '/chat-feedback/stats' -> change to '/chat/feedback/stats'.

3. In apps/frontend/src/utils/api.jsx: Change adminGetUnacknowledgedAlertCount from '/admin/alerts/unacknowledged-count' to '/admin/alerts/unacknowledged/count' (the backend uses a slash, not a hyphen).

4. In apps/frontend/src/utils/api.jsx: Change adminUpdateSettings from axios.patch to axios.put. The backend only defines @router.put('/settings') so PATCH will get 405. Change `axios.patch(`${API_BASE}/admin/settings`, data, ...)` to `axios.put(`${API_BASE}/admin/settings`, data, ...)`.
acceptance_criteria: api.jsx chat feedback functions use '/chat/feedback' path (not '/chat-feedback')
api.jsx adminUpdateSettings uses axios.put instead of axios.patch
verification: Grep for '/voice/tts' in frontend - should find 0 results
Grep for '/chat-feedback' in frontend - should find 0 results
Grep for 'unacknowledged-count' in frontend - should find 0 results
findings: All 6 changes applied successfully. Verification confirmed no remaining references to the old paths in frontend code. A comment in SyraAssistant.jsx still mentions 'unacknowledged-count' as documentation text but it does not affect any API call.
